Archive immutable original ZIP bytes under their SHA-256 before parsing
Create a 60-second signed private-object read URL
Send fixed directory_parse operation, object URL and SHA through HMAC and nonce verification
Node validates source URL/hash/ZIP bounds/CRC and parses complete XML
Edge validates the bounded hash-bound listed-identity result before saving the snapshot

integration_assertions: Original bytes and SHA retained through archive, signed read, Node parse and snapshot save
Substituted source bytes fail without snapshot publication
Discovery Edge import graph excludes ZIP inflation and full XML parser dependencies
